construction: 59 parts in source steps 2–16 (step 1 holds only a commented-out line). Steps 2–3: side-stud plates and bricks. Step 4: a colour-coded pink-and-green core child (`Step 18`). Step 5: six white 1×2×1⅔ side-stud bricks close around it. Steps 8–15: curved slopes with left and right cutouts and 1×1 corner-round tiles shape the brow and crest. Steps 7 and 16: children `Steps 21 to 25` and `Step 34`.
interfaces: Stud directions: 59 parts, 28 up, 20 −Z (face forward), 4 each ±X, 3 +Z.
lesson: An animal face built studs-forward on a hidden core.
reuse_notes: Build the core in a contrasting colour, then cover it with forward-facing face parts.
